title: Exact characterisation of maximum-angle conditions for spherical finite element meshes
summary: Maximum-angle conditions are standard finite-element mesh hypotheses that permit anisotropic triangles excluded by minimum-angle or shape-regularity assumptions. For exact spherical triangles, however, the angles of the chordal affine core and the intrinsic spherical angles need not coincide, while radial geometry introduces curvature-scale distortion. We give an algebraic characterisation of the intrinsic spherical maximum-angle condition through a dimensionless quantity computed from the three vertex vectors.
